project_type: Cost-minimized fully-serverless AWS quiz application. Infrastructure-as-code with AWS CDK v2 (TypeScript). Single stack. Backend = API Gateway v2 HTTP API -> ARM64 Node.js 22 Lambda -> DynamoDB single-table (on-demand). Frontend = dependency-free vanilla-JS SPA.
build_system: npm scripts. `npm run build` = tsc. CDK app entry cdk.json -> `npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts bin/quiz-app.ts`. NodejsFunction bundles the Lambda via esbuild (local dep, no Docker) at synth time; @aws-sdk/* is marked external because the Node 22 runtime provides AWS SDK v3.
test_framework: jest + ts-jest. Config in jest.config.js, roots=<rootDir>/test, testMatch **/*.test.ts. Two suites: test/quiz-app-stack.test.ts (aws-cdk-lib/assertions Template synth) and test/handler.test.ts (pure-function unit tests importing REAL exports scoreAnswers/toPublicQuestions from lambda/index.ts).
build_command: env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm ci && npm run build
verification_instructions: All of build/test/synth MUST run on the user's networked machine (EC2 host), NOT in-sandbox. Full verification: `env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm ci && npm run build && npm test && npx cdk synth`. The `env -u NODE_OPTIONS` prefix is a sandbox workaround for a broken NODE_OPTIONS; the user's real machine likely does not need it. Amplify Hosting and Cognito Hosted UI are validated by the user in the AWS console after `cdk deploy` (connect the Git repo to Amplify, set env vars, create the first admin user in the Cognito pool).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. tsc output (*.js/*.d.ts under bin/lib/lambda) and cdk.out are gitignored. frontend/** is force-un-ignored so static assets are tracked.
setup_instructions: npm ci to install deps. No secrets required for build/synth. Deploy requires AWS credentials + one-time `npx cdk bootstrap`.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network in-sandbox: public npm registry returns 403, so npm install / tsc / jest / cdk synth / cdk deploy CANNOT run here. All edits must be correct-by-construction and verified by reading. Feasible in-sandbox checks: JSON validity, `node --check` on plain-JS frontend files, import-resolution reasoning. No Docker daemon. Do NOT attempt real AWS deploys.
contribution_requirements: Commit onto existing branch feat/cdk-scaffold (do NOT create a new branch, do NOT push - orchestrator publishes, updating PR #1). Keep cost-minimized/serverless spirit: no VPC/NAT, no provisioned capacity, no always-on/idle-billed resources. Cognito User Pools + API Gateway JWT authorizer add no idle cost; Amplify Hosting has build-minute + hosting cost only.
key_patterns: DynamoDB single-table: quiz meta item = {pk:'QUIZ#<quizId>', sk:'META', type:'META', quizId, title, questionCount}; question item = {pk:'QUIZ#<quizId>', sk:'Q#<n>', type:'QUESTION', quizId, n, text, options, answerIndex}. Lambda routes dispatched by event.routeKey string match. Security-critical: answerIndex is stripped via exported pure fn toPublicQuestions before any client response; scoring is exported pure fn scoreAnswers. Handler returns via json(statusCode, body) helper with content-type + CORS headers. Seed data (SAMPLE_QUIZZES) in lambda/seed-data.ts with SeedQuiz/SeedQuestion interfaces; seeded via BatchWrite (chunks of 25) with UnprocessedItems retry on first empty-table GET /api/quizzes. Frontend is vanilla JS, no build step, no framework; app.js has fetchJson with a content-type guard; API_BASE from window.API_BASE (config.js), default '/api'. CDK stack uses aws-cdk-lib L2 constructs; CfnOutputs for ApiEndpoint/CloudFrontDomain/TableName.

directory_structure: bin/ = CDK app entry. lib/ = stack definition. lambda/ = handler + seed data (bundled by NodejsFunction). frontend/ = static SPA assets (force-tracked). test/ = jest suites. cdk.json/tsconfig.json/jest.config.js/package.json at root. README.md in Japanese.
